Title: Retry + Automatic Escalation DECISION Engine
Summary: Decision-engine-only retry + automatic escalation planner. Every outcome is a RECOMMENDATION (Status + Action + ReasonCodes); AUTO_EXECUTION_ENABLED = FALSE, ExecutionMode=AUTO refused (AUTO_EXECUTION_PROHIBITED), 0 paid API calls, 0 network calls, no live AI/provider invocation, no autonomous Nexus changes. Pipeline: AUTO -> chain assembly -> human intervention -> verified success -> verification-authoritative classification -> governance/auth/budget -> attempt limit -> category action table -> finalize (loop protection + request-ceiling re-check). EscalationPolicy v1 bounds every budget/gate/tie-break; no budget is hard-coded in engine logic. EscalationChain v1 preserves every attempt append-only (DB-M17 read-only). Human Git gates and Claude review gates are never bypassed; non-AI failures (scope/governance/git/PR/merge/architecture) stop or go to a human, never to a stronger model. Verification is authoritative: model says PASS / DB-M06 says FAIL => FAILURE (VERIFICATION_FAILURE, CORRECT_CURRENT_ATTEMPT, focused FIX over rebuild). Reasoning escalation is one step LOW->MEDIUM->HIGH->MAX only when the model supports it and policy permits; never an automatic jump to MAX. Model escalation considers only DB-M19 ELIGIBLE candidates; hard capability filters are never bypassed. No infinite retry loops (MaxAttemptsPerTask + MaxSameModelRetries + MaxReasoningEscalations + MaxModelEscalations + chain LoopFree + exact-combination loop check -> LOOP_PREVENTED). Cost is via the DB-M16 engine through the DB-M19 STEP 3 estimator (math never duplicated); request-level MaxAllowedCost ceiling only, no daily/monthly/org/retry-pool/team budgets (DB-M21 territory); incremental + cumulative costs always present. DB-M24 evidence influences ranking only when ConfidenceSufficient; INSUFFICIENT confidence never produces overconfident escalation. Mandatory governance context never removed. Deterministic pure function of (input, policy, preserved chain); ADR-005 (no provider/model name branching). Exports confined to DB-M20-owned state; Nexus paths, outside-root paths and live handoff artifacts refused.

S14 reasoning escalation one step (LOW->MEDIUM); S15 no jump to MAX (LOW->MEDIUM even when MAX supported; HIGH->MAX one step; budget/support blocked); S16 model escalation to an eligible candidate; S17 hard filters never bypassed (rejected candidate never re-admitted; S23 failure classification precedence (verification authoritative, governance/auth protected, unknown recorded category throws); S24 retry gates (governance/unknown never blindly retried, attempt bound, non-loop-free chain refused);
